svg.title: Figure 2 — Boot sequence of init()
svg.desc: A vertical flow of the twenty-three ordered steps performed by init(), grouped into six phases: store construction, canvas acquisition, first paint of the surfaces, event wiring, first view, and the frame loop. Each step carries its precondition on the right.
svg.text: FIGURE 2
Boot sequence — the ordered steps of init()
Entry point: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init). Steps run synchronously, top to bottom; a filled marker denotes a hard precondition.
A hard precondition means the step throws, or silently paints nothing, if the condition is not already true.
STORE CONSTRUCTION
CANVAS
FIRST PAINT OF THE SURFACES
WIRING
FIRST VIEW
LOOP
buildTBox()
No precondition. Materialises store.ent and store.tbox from CLASS_SPEC.
Must complete before anything else reads the Store.
generateIndividuals(12000)
Requires buildTBox(): every record carries a pizza: class IRI as rec.type.
Resets inds, indIndex, byType and customers; bumps store.version.
buildReverseIndex()
Requires the complete entity set. Walks restrictions, equivalents, domain
and range to build revRestriction: filler IRI to list of referring entities.
buildRBox()
Requires the complete entity set. Flattens every some- and value-restriction
into store.rbox so a query matches it without walking blank nodes.
canvasEl, ctx, miniEl, mctx
Requires the DOM: #canvas and #minimap must both exist. Everything in the
renderer and the export path assumes these four bindings are non-null.
refreshPalette()
Requires data-theme to be resolved on documentElement. Snapshots the
computed custom properties into palette; must re-run on every theme change.
resizeCanvas()
Requires both canvases and window.devicePixelRatio. Sets the backing store
to clientWidth × dpr, dpr capped at 2, and applies the dpr transform.
UI.expanded ← DEFAULT_OPEN
No precondition. Opens owl:Thing, pizza:DomainConcept, pizza:Food,
pizza:Pizza and pizza:PizzaTopping so the tree lands on something useful.
renderLegend()
Requires KIND_META. Emits one legend item per Entity kind, plus the pinned
swatch and the plus-n gloss; colour comes from the token in KIND_META.colour.
renderTree()
Requires the TBox and UI.expanded. Renders only open rows, so the cost is
proportional to what is visible rather than to the class count.
renderTableHead()
Requires COLS only. Writes the --cols grid template that the header and
every row share, so columns cannot drift apart.
populateFilterOptions()
Requires store.byType, which only exists after generateIndividuals(). Builds
the type and branch option lists with their per-type counts.
applyFilters()
Requires renderTableHead() and the populated selects. Produces TBL.rows and
calls renderTableRows() for the visible window only.
renderInspector()
UI.selection is still null at this point, so the empty state renders. Proving
the empty state on boot is deliberate, not incidental.
updateStoreUI()
Requires the Store. Writes the status-bar triple, class and individual counts;
tripleCount() counts generated triples rather than materialising them.
wire()
Requires every element wire() addresses to exist, which is why it follows the
first paint rather than preceding it. Binds pointer, keyboard and splitter handlers.
seedView([pizza:Pizza])
Requires the adjacency index and a sized canvas. Clears the view, sets the
focus set, admits the seed, expands it, then calls relayout() and fitView().
expandNode(pizza:NamedPizza, 30)
Requires pizza:NamedPizza to be in the view already, which the seed expansion
guarantees. The explicit cap of 30 keeps the first frame well inside the budget.
relayout({ fresh: true })
Re-run after the expansion so the layout sees the final node set. fresh forces
deterministic phyllotaxis seeding rather than resuming from the old positions.
fitView()
Requires canvasEl.clientWidth to be non-zero, so it must follow layout on a
canvas that has been laid out. Clamps scale to the range 0.05 to 1.9.
selectEntity(pizza:Pizza)
Populates the inspector, marks the tree row, and writes the status-bar selection
field. See Figure 5 for the full bus.
updateBudgetUI()
Requires G to be in its final boot state. Writes the meter width and its near
and full states, the in-view counts, the zoom, and the empty-state visibility.
requestAnimationFrame(frame)
Starts the loop: frame() calls stepLayout() then draw(), and re-schedules itself
for the life of the window. stepLayout() relayouts only when layoutKey() changes.
Figure 2 · Boot sequence. Illustrates 10-architecture.md, “Start-up order”, and 60-implementation-plan.md, “Phase gates”. [src: init()]
The order is load-bearing: the Store is complete before any Surface paints, every Surface has painted before wire() binds to it, and the first view is seeded only once the canvas has a size.
